entities.title: On a push to main or a pull request
entities.summary: Lints, tests and builds every tool on macOS and Linux, checks the release scripts, the minimum Rust version and branch coverage.
entities.trigger: A push to main, any pull request, or a manual run (ci.yml). A newer run on the same ref cancels the older one.
checks: lint (Linux): cargo fmt --all --check; shellcheck of the release scripts, pgo.sh and the version scripts included; macos/release/sign-and-notarize.test.sh, formula.test.sh, version.test.sh, fetch-cyberspace-generator.test.sh and language-modules.test.sh; cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets, warnings as errors

test (macOS and Linux, stable Rust with the wasm32-wasip1 target): a release build of zazz-worker for the zazz tests; on macOS first the zazzled zazz:: tests one at a time under a 15-minute limit; cargo test --workspace (run even when that step failed), with a single-threaded rerun of the zazzled tests to name a failure; a release build, and a smoke run of afs, fix-network --help and free-disk-space clean caches (a dry run)
msrv (Linux): cargo check --workspace --exclude zazz-worker with Rust 1.85, the workspace's rust-version
zazzle-c (macOS and Linux): build zazzled, then make, make unit and test/smoke.sh for the C invoker

coverage (Linux, nightly with the wasm32-wasip1 target): agent-fs and fix-network fail below 95% of lines and of branches; zazzled/coverage.sh 95 for zazzled, then for zazz-format, zazz-sdk and zazz-worker; make coverage for the C invoker

dotnet (macOS and Linux): dotnet test tests, dotnet publish, and a smoke run of zazzle-csharp-indexer serve (initialize, an empty tools/list and the overview tool called by name) and zazzle-csharp-indexer report
entities.blocks: Nothing on its own: whether main waits for it is set in the repository's rules on GitHub, outside this repository.
notChecked: The .dev files and Actors/: the HASD validators are not run in CI.
zazz-worker's own minimum Rust version (1.97): the msrv job leaves it out, and the other jobs use stable or nightly.
free-disk-space line and branch coverage: no coverage gate runs for it.
macOS Keychain trust for signed zazz scripts: the tests use their own trust directory, so the Keychain path compiles but is not exercised.
The macOS-only behaviour that needs a real Mac (fix-network repairs, free-disk-space compress, dedupe --apply, Finder trash and Docker steps): the tests run against stand-ins.
pgo.sh itself: CI only shellchecks it; the release and the bench run it.

entities.title: On a release run or a vX.Y.Z tag
entities.summary: Works out the version from the tags, stamps it into every binary, tests and builds every tool, zazz-worker, the zazzle invoker (shipped also as zazz) and the C# indexer, signs the macOS binaries when configured, and publishes the macOS and Linux tarballs, the Homebrew bottle and the zazzle formula.
entities.trigger: A manual run of release.yml with bump patch (the default), minor or major, which releases the next version after the latest vX.Y.Z tag; or a pushed tag v*, which must be vX.Y.Z. A manual run with bump none builds and tests but publishes nothing.
checks: version: version.sh prints the tag, the version (0.0.0-dev for a build-only run) and whether to publish; a manual release run tags the commit and pushes the tag
macos and linux: set-version.sh writes the version into every crate's manifest and Cargo.lock entry; the indexer is published with -p:Version

macos (stable Rust with the arm64, x86_64 and wasm32-wasip1 targets): a release build of zazz-worker, then cargo test --workspace; pgo.sh trains a clang profile for zazzled's C code; language-modules.sh builds the 25 language modules for both architectures and lipo joins them, sign-and-notarize.sh signs them when configured, and their manifest is written; release builds for arm64 and x86_64 with that profile and the manifest embedded; make, make unit and test/smoke.sh for the zazzle invoker (arm64 only); lipo into universal binaries (zazzled, zazz-worker, afs, fix-network, free-disk-space); the invoker copied as zazzle and as zazz
macos: dotnet test, then zazzle-csharp-indexer published for osx-arm64 and osx-x64 and gzipped, one file per CPU type

macos: sign-and-notarize.sh on zazzle, zazz, zazzled, zazz-worker (with entitlements/zazz-worker.plist), afs, fix-network, free-disk-space and cyberspace-generator (fetched by fetch-cyberspace-generator.sh and merged with lipo); it skips with a warning when the Apple secrets are missing, and fails when the variable REQUIRE_SIGNING is true

macos: pack zazzle-macos-universal.tar.gz (zazzle, zazz, zazzled, zazz-worker, afs, fix-network, free-disk-space, cyberspace-generator and the two gzipped indexers) with its .sha256; create the GitHub release, with no release notes; copy both to the download bucket under zazzle/<tag>/ and zazzle/latest/

linux (x86_64 and aarch64, after macos; stable Rust with the wasm32-wasip1 target): a release build of zazz-worker and cargo test -p zazzled; build zazzled with a PGO profile; build and test the invoker; dotnet test and publish the indexer; attach zazzle-linux-<arch>.tar.gz (zazzle, zazz, zazzled, zazz-worker, zazzle-csharp-indexer, cyberspace-generator) to the release and copy it to the same bucket folders
homebrew (after macos): bottle.sh, upload the bottle to the release, formula.sh writes Formula/zazzle.rb into a checkout of the zazzcat/homebrew-z tap and pushes it there
entities.blocks: The release: a pushed tag that is not vX.Y.Z, or a failed test, build, smoke test, profile training, signing step (when required) or notarization, stops the job before it publishes.
notChecked: Signing and notarization against Apple: nothing has signed a real binary until a tag runs with the secrets in place.
That the published formula installs: formula.test.sh runs it under a stand-in Formula class in CI, not under Homebrew.

entities.title: zazzle benchmarks
entities.summary: Builds zazzled and the zazzle invoker, smoke tests them, prints spawn latencies and times refs over the crate sources, without and with the PGO profile, on macOS and Linux runners.
entities.trigger: A pull request that changes macos/c/zazzle/, macos/rust/zazzled/, macos/release/pgo.sh or this workflow, or a manual run with a number of spawns per row.
checks: cargo build --release -p zazzled; make; test/smoke.sh; bench/run.sh; bench/refs.sh
pgo.sh, a zazzled build with the profile, and bench/refs.sh against it
entities.blocks: Nothing: the benchmark prints readings and has no threshold.
notChecked: Its PGO numbers are an upper bound: it trains and measures on the same crate sources.

entities.title: Weekly dependency updates
entities.summary: Dependabot opens pull requests for the Cargo workspace's crates and for the GitHub Actions the workflows use, each weekly.
checks: None of its own: its pull requests run the ci pipeline.
notChecked: The .NET packages of zazzle-csharp-indexer: dependabot.yml has no nuget entry.

entities.title: Daily cyberspace-generator pin bump
entities.summary: Opens a pull request that moves macos/release/cyberspace-generator.version to the newest generator-v* release of cyberspace-explorer, so the next zazzle release ships it.
entities.trigger: Daily at 05:17 UTC, by hand, or a repository_dispatch of type cyberspace-generator-released.
checks: The newest release has all four binaries (both macOS CPU types, static Linux x86_64 and aarch64) and they match its SHA256SUMS (fetch-cyberspace-generator.sh).
It dispatches ci.yml on the new branch, because a pull request opened with GITHUB_TOKEN starts no workflows.
entities.blocks: Nothing: it only opens a pull request; skips when the pin is current or the branch already exists.
notChecked: That the new release passes the zazzle formula's test block: only a zazzle release runs it.
